subject: inorganic
question:
无机化学·配位化学：请判断下列配合物的几何构型：Tetraammineplatinum(II)（[Pt(NH₃)₄]²⁺）？
A. Square planar
B. Tetrahedral
C. Trigonal planar
D. Trigonal bipyramidal
explanation: Square planar. Covalent count: Pt (group 10) 10 e; 4 × NH₃ (L) 8 e; the 2+ charge removes 2 e: 16 e. Ionic count: the ligands carry no charge and the complex has a 2+ charge, so the metal is Pt(II), d⁸; d⁸ + 8 e from the ligands = 16 e.
